title: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.34825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM routing aims to choose, for each prompt, which model in a portfolio is most likely to answer correctly. This only makes sense when the benchmark contains enough prompt-specific variation for different models to be best on different inputs. On coarse-scored LLM benchmarks, however, many models often tie for the best score, and the single best model may already leave little room for improvement. We therefore propose a routeability-first audit, instantiated as RAP and RouteabilityBench, a runnable claim-verification package. The audit is retrospective: it runs once the benchmark-portfolio score matrix exists and before router comparisons are interpreted as general evidence, rather than certifying a portfolio that has not yet been evaluated. Across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs, generic routing enhancements such as larger embedding sets, dimensionality reduction, selective abstention, clustering, and stronger regressors do not consistently

translated_title: 路由之前的可路由性：用于经审计的LLM模型选择的可路由性审计协议（RAP）与RouteabilityBench
translated_abstract: LLM路由的目标是，针对每个提示，从模型组合中选出最有可能正确回答的模型。这只有在基准测试包含足够多的提示特定差异、使不同模型能在不同输入上各自成为最佳时才有意义。然而，在采用粗粒度评分的LLM基准测试中，许多模型往往在最佳得分上并列，且单一的 最佳模型可能已几乎没有改进空间。因此，我们提出了一种“可路由性优先”的审计方法，具体实现为RAP与RouteabilityBench，一个可运行的声明验证软件包。该审计是回顾性的：它在基准测试—模型组合评分矩阵已经存在之后、在将路由器比较结果解读为一般性证据之前运行，而非对尚未评估的模型组合进行认证。在四个基准测试和66个LLM上，诸如更大嵌入集合、降维、选择性弃权、聚类和更强回归器等通用路由增强手段并不能一致地（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在进行LLM路由方法评估之前先审计基准测试的“可路由性”，并发布了可运行的审计协议RAP和基准套件RouteabilityBench，实验发现跨四个基准和66个LLM的通用路由增强手段并不能带来一致的改进。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes auditing a benchmark's "routeability" before evaluating LLM routing methods, introducing a runnable audit protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench, and showing across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs that generic routing enhancements do not consistently improve performance.
